  "reasons": [

      "premise_quote": "market demand is qD = 200 - p and market supply is qS = 120 + p (quantities in kg, price p in rupees per kg, with p at least 10). If the price is fixed at Rs 60 per kg",
      "reason": "At p = 60, qS = 180 and qD = 140, yielding excess supply of 180 - 140 = 40 kg."
    },

      "status": "contradicted",
